==Biography==
Joaquín José Pérez Valdivieso is from Santiago, Chile.

=== 2015 Season===
His debut was in [[Game Over]] as mid laner participating in the [[Circuito de Leyendas Sur/2015 Season/Closing Season|2015 CDLS Closing Season]] where the team was penultimate in the tournament, unable to qualify, at the end of the tournament leaves the team.

=== 2016 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joined [[Dark Horse]] as a substitute mid laner participating in minor tournaments, at mid-year he leaves the team.

At mid-year, he joined [[Kaos Latin Gamers|KLG]] as a mid laner participating in the [[LAS 2016 Closing Cup]] where the team was third in the tournament, qualifying for the next phase. Already in the [[LAS 2016 Closing Cup Playoffs]] the team reached the final facing [[Isurus]] winning 3-2, qualifying for the first time to an international tournament. Already in [[IWCQ 2016]] the team was penultimate in the tournament achieving only one victory. In the [[IEM Season 11 Challenger]] the team loses against [[INTZ e-Sports]] 2-0 reaching a loser bracket facing [[Lyon Gaming (2013 Latin American Team)|Lyon Gaming]] losing 2-0, being eliminated from their second international tournament.

=== 2017 Season===
In the [[CLS 2017 Opening]] the team was last in the tournament, having to play the relegation. Already in the [[CLS 2017 Closing Promotion]] the team faced [[Legatum]] winning 3-1, saving their place. In the middle of the year [[Plugo]] he remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2017 Closing]] where the team was first in the lathe, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2017 Closing Playoffs]] the team reaches the final facing [[Isurus]] winning 3-1, qualifying for the World Cup. In the World Cup the team played Group C facing [[Fnatic]] and [[Young Generation]] where the team was last in the group with only one victory.

=== 2018 Season===
At the beginning of the year [[Plugo]] is still in the team participating in the [[CLS 2018 Opening]] where the team was second in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Opening Playoffs]] the team reaches the final facing [[Rebirth eSports]] winning 3-2, qualifying the MSI. In the MSI the team was in group A facing [[Gambit Esports]], [[Rainbow 7]] and [[Ascension Gaming]] where the team was last in the group with the Asian team. At mid-year [[Plugo]] he remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2018 Closing]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Closing Playoffs]] the team reaches the final again facing [[Rebirth eSports]] winning 3-1, qualifying for the second time to the World Cup. In the World Cup the team remained in group d facing [[Gambit Esports]] and [[G-Rex]] where the team was last in the group without victory, at the end of the tournament leaves the team.

=== 2019 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joins [[All Knights]] as Mid Laner participating in the [[LLA 2019 Opening]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LLA 2019 Opening Playoffs]] the team was third in the tournament losing against [[Isurus]] 2-3. At mid-year [[Plugo]] he remains in the team participating in the [[LLA 2019 Closing]] where the team was second in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LLA 2019 Closing Playoffs]] the team reaches the final facing [[Isurus]] losing 0-3.
